إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ

قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

parent_channels.name: P1 (51:1-23): Directed Provision

subchannels.name: Atmospheric Freight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind sorts and transports a heavy, rain-bearing load until what is held aloft falls as provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: winnowing scatter (`quranic:root_000513:B004/m01`); visible load-bearing (`quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`); heavy freight (`quranic:root_001674:B002/m01`); rain-bearing cloud (`quranic:root_000357:B010/m01`); cloud and rain (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m02`); falling rain (`quranic:root_001675:B003/m01`); rain as provision (`quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Scattering is not mere dispersal. It separates and mobilizes a burden whose latent identity is a rain cloud; the burden's eventual falling turns transport into delivery. The sky's promised provision is thereby materialized as freight moving through an atmospheric distribution chain.

subchannels.name: Routed Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Released water enters channels, arrives from elsewhere, and gathers in springs before continuing through the landscape.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing water (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); watercourse or channel (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); incoming flood from another land (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); spring or water source (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`); rainfall as provision (`quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The running motion of 51:3 acquires a hydrological mechanism. Water comes, enters a course, and emerges as a spring; provision is not static abundance but a routed arrival whose path joins sky and inhabited ground.

subchannels.name: Fertility and Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water-bearing movement culminates in fertile soil, protected growth, and produce carried to maturity.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile planted land (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); sheltered orchard (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense plant growth (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); crop and palm yield with abundant water (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); fruit carried on the plant (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Bearing recurs at the productive end of the supply chain: land receives water, vegetation thickens behind the garden's enclosure, and the plant itself becomes a bearer. Atmospheric carriage is reframed as the first phase of biological yield.

subchannels.name: The Allotted Human Share
subchannels.scene_or_process: Provision is divided, received, held as wealth, and transferred to one whose claim or deprivation makes a share due.
subchannels.active_motifs: apportioning shares (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`); allotted provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); continuing grant (`quranic:root_000240:B006/m01`); taking into possession (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); wealth or property (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); a holder's specific right (`quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`); asking for a share (`quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`); deprivation of expected provision (`quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Cosmic division and ethical giving share one operation: making a measured portion reach its proper recipient. The claimant and the deprived are not appended to the provision scene; they reveal its terminal obligation, where flow becomes possession and possession remains answerable to a right.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustenance becomes available through directed movement, containment, release, cultivation, and measured transfer.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:1-4 wind, bearing, running, and division; 51:15 springs and gardens; 51:19 an acknowledged claim in wealth; 51:22 provision in the sky.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The opening motions resolve into one supply system: atmospheric freight becomes routed water, productive land, and finally an apportioned human share.

parent_channels.name: P1 (51:1-23): A Promise Coming Due

subchannels.name: Commitment, Fulfillment, and Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: A truthful undertaking is fulfilled when its obligation falls due and enters account.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding promise (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); truthful statement (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); fulfillment in action (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); account and recompense (`quranic:root_000504:B002/m01`); debt (`quranic:root_000504:B003/m01`); becoming fixed or due (`quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`); due obligation (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The promise is construed as more than reliable speech. Its truth is performance, its arrival is a debt becoming due, and the Day of Recompense is the accounting form of that fulfilled commitment.

subchannels.name: Appointment and Premature Demand
subchannels.scene_or_process: A threatened event has an appointed day, while those under warning try to pull that date forward.
subchannels.active_motifs: menace within a promise (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); fixed appointment in time (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); day as bounded time (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); decisive event or calamity (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); haste and premature demand (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The question about the Day is an attempt to alter the timing of an appointment already contained in the warning. Haste cannot accelerate what is fixed; it only exposes the demander's position beneath the approaching event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A declared commitment moves toward a fixed point at which truth becomes an enforceable account.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:5-6 the truthful promise and the coming reckoning; 51:12-14 the demanded day and tasted trial; 51:22-23 the repeated promise and oath of truth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Promise, debt, appointment, and impact converge on the image of an obligation that does not merely occur but matures into something due.

parent_channels.name: P1 (51:1-23): Truth Made Legible

subchannels.name: Woven Order and Distorted Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: A tightly interwoven pattern supplies a standard against which divergent, diverted, and conjectural speech appears structurally unfit.
subchannels.active_motifs: precise construction (`quranic:root_000290:B001/m01`); interwoven paths (`quranic:root_000290:B002/m01`); tight fastening (`quranic:root_000290:B003/m01`); divergent paths and disagreement (`quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); diversion from truth (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); unsupported claim (`quranic:root_000403:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The woven heaven and the conflicting saying are related by fit. One displays paths held in an ordered fabric; the other separates into incompatible routes and then turns hearers away through estimation without knowledge.

subchannels.name: Furnace Assay
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons and claims are assayed as material is exposed to fire, with tasting supplying direct experiential verification.
subchannels.active_motifs: assaying metal or character (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); burning and blackening by fire (`quranic:root_001128:B002/m01`); trial or affliction (`quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`); fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); experiential tasting of affliction (`quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Trial is a furnace operation: exposure reveals what the subject is, while tasting removes the distance of speculation. The demanded judgment becomes knowledge acquired through contact with the test itself.

subchannels.name: Embodied Witness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Signs are inspected in the earth and the self until inner sight and articulate evidence make certainty answerable.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); fixed certainty (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`); eyesight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward insight (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); the self or essence (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); inner reason or intention (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); intelligible speech (`quranic:root_001519:B001/m01`); evidence that speaks by revealing (`quranic:root_001519:B002/m01`); truth fixed to reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The self is both inspected object and interior faculty of recognition. Sight develops into insight, and the final comparison with speech makes truth function as a witness whose coherence is as immediate as one's own act of speaking.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reality discloses itself through ordered form, diagnostic testing, and witnesses within the perceiver.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:7-11 woven heaven, conflicting speech, diversion, conjecture, and heedlessness; 51:13-14 trial by fire; 51:20-23 signs in earth and selves and truth likened to speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textile, furnace, and bodily speech are three technologies of verification: fit can be inspected, material can be assayed, and evidence can answer from within.

parent_channels.name: P1 (51:1-23): Protective Coverings

subchannels.name: Garden as Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: An enclosure wards harm and holds a watered interior fit for protected life.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment and cover (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); sheltered orchard (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); barrier warding harm (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself under protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); spring or water source (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The garden is not only productive land but an enclosure. Protection forms its boundary, springs sustain its interior, and the protected ones inhabit the same sheltering image carried by the garden's root.

subchannels.name: Night Cover and Predawn Repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night covers the sleeper, but curtailed sleep opens into a predawn act that covers fault.
subchannels.active_motifs: night as a covering (`quranic:root_000266:B002/m01`); night and darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); light sleep (`quranic:root_001579:B001/m01`); predawn (`quranic:root_000682:B004/m01`); covering or protecting (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); forgiveness as covering sin (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: A natural cover and an ethical cover overlap without collapsing. The night permits sleep, restraint leaves part of it wakeful, and at dawn forgiveness supplies the protection that sleep itself cannot provide.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Covering creates a protected interior in which life, rest, and repair can occur.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 51:15 gardens and springs, 51:17-18 little sleep and predawn forgiveness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The enclosed garden and the covered night share a sheltering function, while forgiveness becomes a moral covering applied at the night's opening edge.

parent_channels.name: P2 (51:24-37): Household Reception

subchannels.name: Strangers at the Threshold
subchannels.scene_or_process: Honored outsiders arrive, cross into a household, exchange peace, and remain socially unrecognized.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival and reaching (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); stranger entering another people (`quranic:root_000009:B006/m01`); guest and host relation (`quranic:root_000924:B002/m01`); honor and generosity (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); peace and reconciliation (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); unfamiliar person (`quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:24 `أَتَىٰ` (ء ت ي), `ضَيْفِ` (ض ي ف), `مُكْرَمِينَ` (ك ر م); 51:25 `دَخَلُ` (د خ ل), `سَلَٰمًا/سَلَٰمٌ` (س ل م), `مُّنكَرُونَ` (ن ك ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Entry changes the visitors from distant arrivals into household participants, but the greeting does not settle their identity. Honor governs Abraham's conduct while unfamiliarity keeps the threshold socially active inside the room.

subchannels.name: Preparing and Presenting the Feast
subchannels.scene_or_process: The host turns privately toward his household, prepares a rich calf, and places it within reach of the guests.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed side movement (`quranic:root_000613:B001/m01`); rolling a morsel in fat (`quranic:root_000613:B003/m01`); household and kin (`quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`); bringing or presenting (`quranic:root_000281:B004/m01`); calf (`quranic:root_000987:B002/m01`); fatness (`quranic:root_000744:B001/m01`); ghee or fatty condiment (`quranic:root_000744:B002/m01`); drawing near (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); eating (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The meal is a complete hospitality mechanism: discreet withdrawal protects generosity from display, the household supplies the prepared animal, and presentation converts possession into an offered share placed near enough to eat.

subchannels.name: The Untouched Meal as Signal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Failure to eat is detected through slight signs, becomes inward fear, and is answered by speech of reassurance and good news.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`); tasting food little by little (`quranic:root_001627:B004/m01`); hidden sound (`quranic:root_001627:B001/m01`); listening for a hidden sound (`quranic:root_001627:B001/m02`); fear or intuition in the heart (`quranic:root_001627:B002/m01`); fear (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); good news opening the face with joy (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The guests' abstention makes the meal diagnostic. Abraham's sensing is rendered as attention to barely perceptible evidence, and reassurance reverses that inward alarm into the outward opening of good news.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A household tests unknown arrivals by threshold, greeting, food, and bodily response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:24-30 honored guests enter, receive peace and food, trigger fear, and deliver good news.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hospitality becomes an epistemic instrument: an untouched meal and subtle bodily sensing identify the visitors before their message is understood.

parent_channels.name: P2 (51:24-37): Birth at the Threshold of Impossibility

subchannels.name: Aged and Barren, Yet Addressed by Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Good news names a child against the embodied evidence of age and barrenness.
subchannels.active_motifs: good news (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); boy or young son (`quranic:root_001103:B001/m01`); knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); woman (`quranic:root_001409:B001/m01`); old woman or old age (`quranic:root_000985:B003/m01`); a child born late in the parents' age (`quranic:root_000985:B007/m01`); barren womb (`quranic:root_001037:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The announcement confronts two closures, age and barrenness, with a specifically characterized son. Knowledge belongs both to the promised child and to the authority of the promise, displacing bodily probability without denying the body's condition.

subchannels.name: The Body as a Delivery Scene
subchannels.scene_or_process: Approach, cry, hand-to-face movement, and reception assemble the mechanics surrounding childbirth.
subchannels.active_motifs: approaching birth (`quranic:root_001212:B012/m01`); midwife receiving a child (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); cry or shriek (`quranic:root_000856:B004/m01`); forceful collision or slap (`quranic:root_000874:B001/m01`); hands-first delivery (`quranic:root_001630:B010/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The surface gesture of astonishment is simultaneously populated by childbirth operations. The wife's coming forward and cry move toward a scene of reception, while hand and face imagery press the impossible announcement into concrete bodily mechanics.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A body marked as closed to reproduction is approached as a site of imminent reception.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:28-30 a knowledgeable son is announced to an aged, barren woman.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The wife's approach, cry, face, and striking hand activate a delivery scene in which the woman who cannot conceive is lexically positioned to receive a child.

parent_channels.name: P2 (51:24-37): Authorized Targeting

subchannels.name: The Sealed Warrant
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign decision becomes delegated authority, a written instrument, and a sealed dispatch carried by envoys.
subchannels.active_motifs: judicial decision (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); delegated adjudication or authorization (`quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`); sovereign or master (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); grave affair (`quranic:root_000421:B003/m01`); dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); written deed or document (`quranic:root_000874:B006/m01`); clay seal (`quranic:root_000963:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The envoys' commission reads as an authorized instrument. Wisdom decides, lordship authorizes, dispatch transmits, and the latent deed-and-seal imagery gives the spoken mission the material integrity of a warrant.

subchannels.name: Marked Clay-Stone Consignment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clay is hardened into stones, marked, held before authority, and released toward designated recipients.
subchannels.active_motifs: clay material (`quranic:root_000963:B001/m01`); hard stone (`quranic:root_000296:B003/m01`); marking or inscription (`quranic:root_000764:B004/m01`); held or present before authority (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`); dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Material, manufacture, custody, and destination form one delivery chain. The stones are not undifferentiated debris; their marking makes each projectile a targeted unit held under authority before dispatch.

subchannels.name: Offense Beyond the Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prohibited boundary is crossed, defining the offending population to whom the judgment is addressed.
subchannels.active_motifs: offense or crime (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`); prohibition and restraint (`quranic:root_000296:B001/m01`); exceeding bounds (`quranic:root_000699:B001/m01`); judicial decision (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The target class is produced by a boundary relation: restraint establishes a limit, excess crosses it, and crime names the resulting status. Judgment and projectile destination therefore share the same act of specification.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment moves from sovereign decision to documented authorization, marked material, and a bounded class of offenders.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:30-34 the wise Lord's envoys identify their commission and its marked clay stones for transgressors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Writing, sealing, marking, and projectile material turn the decree into a physical consignment whose destination is already inscribed.

parent_channels.name: P2 (51:24-37): Selective Extraction and Retained Trace

subchannels.name: Removing the Protected Household
subchannels.scene_or_process: A search identifies the secure household and extracts its believing occupants from concealment and danger.
subchannels.active_motifs: going out (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); extracting from concealment (`quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`); security (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); belief and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); finding (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); dwelling or refuge (`quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`); safety and integrity (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:35 `أَخْرَجْ` (خ ر ج), `مُؤْمِنِينَ` (ء م ن); 51:36 `وَجَدْ` (و ج د), `بَيْتٍ` (ب ي ت), `مُسْلِمِينَ` (س ل م).
subchannels.synthesis: Removal is selective rather than indiscriminate. Finding precedes extraction, and the household functions simultaneously as dwelling, refuge, and the social container in which trust and safety coincide.

subchannels.name: Leaving the Site as Witness
subchannels.scene_or_process: After extraction, a trace remains to make pain and punishment visible to later fear.
subchannels.active_motifs: retained trace or memory (`quranic:root_000180:B002/m01`); visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); fear (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); causing pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:37 `تَرَكْ` (ت ر ك), `ءَايَةً` (ء ي ي), `يَخَافُ` (خ و ف), `عَذَابَ` (ع ذ ب), `أَلِيمَ` (ء ل م).
subchannels.synthesis: What is left is not accidental residue. The trace is curated by survival of place: pain becomes visible, visibility can generate fear, and the judged site continues to act after its inhabitants have been removed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment sorts a site by removing protected occupants while preserving an evidentiary remainder.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:35-37 believers are brought out, one submitting household is found, and a sign is left for those who fear punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Extraction and residue are complementary archival operations: living witnesses are removed from danger while the damaged place is retained as testimony.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Rejected Authority and Reversed Support

subchannels.name: Envoy, Proof, and the Ruler's Strong Side
subchannels.scene_or_process: An envoy arrives with compelling authority while the ruler turns away by leaning on a retinue imagined as structural support.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); compelling proof (`quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`); authority and power (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); manifest clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); exposition (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); turning away (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); strong side, support, or retinue (`quranic:root_000596:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Two forms of authority confront each other. Moses' authority is evidentiary and self-manifesting; Pharaoh's is positional, a side on which he leans. Turning away is thus an enacted preference for support over proof.

subchannels.name: Defensive Labels
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech replaces engagement with proof by classifying the envoy as either deceptive or mentally veiled.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); sorcery as deceptive diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); madness as a veiled mind (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:39 `قَالَ` (ق و ل), `سَٰحِرٌ` (س ح ر), `مَجْنُونٌ` (ج ن ن).
subchannels.synthesis: The paired labels offer incompatible diagnoses but perform the same defense. One blames calculated manipulation and the other incapacity, allowing speech to displace the manifest authority it cannot answer.

subchannels.name: Capture and Casting Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ruler who relied on his force becomes the object of seizure, and his army is discarded into the sea under blame.
subchannels.active_motifs: forcible seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m02`); capture (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); army (`quranic:root_000264:B001/m01`); casting away (`quranic:root_001466:B001/m01`); sea (`quranic:root_001697:B003/m01`); blame and culpability (`quranic:root_001386:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:40 `أَخَذْ` (ء خ ذ), `جُنُودَ` (ج ن د), `نَبَذْ` (ن ب ذ), `يَمِّ` (ي م م), `مُلِيمٌ` (ل و م).
subchannels.synthesis: Agency flips completely. The commander and his instruments become a single captured object, while casting turns the force that was meant to uphold him into discarded material.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A ruler's attempt to resist proof through retinue and labels ends with his own force being seized and discarded.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:38-40 Moses brings manifest authority, Pharaoh turns with his support, labels him, and is cast into the sea with his forces.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Political support is exposed as architectural but unstable: the ruler leans on a strong side until seizure reverses agent and object.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Elemental Unmaking and Lost Capacity

subchannels.name: Sterile Wind to Residue
subchannels.scene_or_process: A released but nonproductive wind reaches each thing, abandons it, and converts it into decayed remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: release of a natural force (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m02`); wind (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); sterility (`quranic:root_001037:B002/m01`); leaving or abandoning (`quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`); arrival and reaching (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); transformation into a state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); decayed remains (`quranic:root_000601:B004/m01`); entity or thing (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:41 `أَرْسَلْ` (ر س ل), `رِّيحَ` (ر و ح), `عَقِيمَ` (ع ق م); 51:42 `أَتَتْ` (ء ت ي), `تَذَرُ` (و ذ ر), `جَعَلَتْ` (ج ع ل), `رَّمِيمِ` (ر م م), `شَىْءٍ` (ش ي ء).
subchannels.synthesis: Sterility names the wind's output as well as its nature: it produces nothing living and leaves nothing productive. Arrival, abandonment, and transformation form a single operation that converts differentiated things into one residue.

subchannels.name: The Measured Respite
subchannels.scene_or_process: Enjoyment occupies a bounded interval before defiant excess meets the governing command.
subchannels.active_motifs: respite for enjoyment (`quranic:root_001395:B007/m01`); bounded interval (`quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`); defiant overreach (`quranic:root_000981:B001/m01`); command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); sovereign or master (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The interval is permissive but not ownerless. Enjoyment fills measured time, overreach mistakes delay for independence, and the command reveals that the respite always remained bounded by another authority.

subchannels.name: Blast, Collapse, and Failed Aid
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thunderous seizure overtakes those still watching, stuns them, removes standing capacity, and forecloses rescue.
subchannels.active_motifs: forcible seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m02`); thunderclap or lightning strike (`quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`); stunned or dead state (`quranic:root_000864:B003/m01`); watching (`quranic:root_001520:B001/m01`); ability (`quranic:root_000956:B003/m01`); standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); stopped or exhausted incapacity (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`); aid (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:44 `أَخَذَتْ` (ء خ ذ), `صَّٰعِقَةُ` (ص ع ق), `يَنظُرُ` (ن ظ ر); 51:45 `ٱسْتَطَٰعُ` (ط و ع), `قِيَامٍ` (ق و م), `مُنتَصِرِينَ` (ن ص ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The blast attacks agency in sequence. Observation remains for an instant, then seizure converts witnesses into the stunned; ability contracts into inability to stand, and social reinforcement disappears with the impossibility of aid.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Released force overtakes a population by progressively removing form, time, stance, and aid.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:41-45 a sterile wind reduces things to decay, a respite ends at the Lord's command, and a blast leaves no capacity to stand or prevail.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Wind and thunder do not merely destroy objects; they dismantle the predicates of agency, from remaining intact to standing and receiving help.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Cosmic Habitation

subchannels.name: Built and Widened Overhead Structure
subchannels.scene_or_process: An overhead canopy is constructed with force, load-bearing supports, and continuing spatial capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: construction (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); ribs, pillars, or load supports (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m01`); overhead canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); force and strength (`quranic:root_000071:B001/m01`); spatial breadth (`quranic:root_001647:B001/m01`); capacity (`quranic:root_001647:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:47 `بَنَيْ` (ب ن ي), `سَّمَآءَ` (س م و), `أَيْي۟دٍ` (ء ي د), `مُوسِعُونَ` (و س ع).
subchannels.synthesis: Building and widening are one architectural process rather than competing images. Strength supplies the structure, rib-like supports distribute its load, and breadth describes the capacity of the completed canopy.

subchannels.name: Furnished and Leveled Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ground is spread, smoothed, and prepared as bedding and cradle for habitation.
subchannels.active_motifs: ground or earth (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); spreading and preparing a surface (`quranic:root_001143:B001/m01`); bedding or furnishing (`quranic:root_001143:B002/m01`); praise and approval (`quranic:root_001525:B003/m01`); cradle (`quranic:root_001451:B001/m01`); prepared bed or smooth ground (`quranic:root_001451:B002/m01`); leveling and preparation (`quranic:root_001451:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:48 `أَرْضَ` (ء ر ض), `فَرَشْ` (ف ر ش), `نِعْمَ` (ن ع م), `مَٰهِدُونَ` (م ه د).
subchannels.synthesis: The earth is not only extended but furnished. Spreading provides area, leveling makes it usable, and the bed-cradle imagery defines excellence by the ground's readiness to receive and sustain inhabitants.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Creation is made habitable through complementary construction above and furnishing below.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:47 the strengthened, expanding built sky and 51:48 the spread earth and excellent preparation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sky carries the anatomy of ribs and supports, while the earth carries the domestic vocabulary of bed and cradle.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Competing Transmissions

subchannels.name: Inherited Formula of Dismissal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each arriving messenger meets a circulating formula passed along across prior communities through reciprocal counsel.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); prior sequence (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); messenger (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); circulating saying (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); sorcery (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); reciprocal counsel or bequeathing (`quranic:root_001656:B003/m01`); social group (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); transgression (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:52 `أَتَى` (ء ت ي), `قَبْلِ` (ق ب ل), `رَّسُولٍ` (ر س ل), `قَالُ` (ق و ل), `سَاحِرٌ` (س ح ر), `مَجْنُونٌ` (ج ن ن); 51:53 `تَوَاصَ` (و ص ي), `قَوْمٌ` (ق و م), `طَاغُونَ` (ط غ ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Recurrence is presented as though communities had transmitted a script to one another. The same labels circulate because the shared act is not diagnosis but refusal; reciprocal counsel gives temporal continuity to transgression.

subchannels.name: Corrective Reminder
subchannels.scene_or_process: After disengagement from entrenched refusal, repeated mention reactivates useful knowledge among those able to trust it.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning away (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); blame (`quranic:root_001386:B001/m01`); recall (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); spoken mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); reminder (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); benefit (`quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`); belief and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Turning away ends an unproductive exchange but not communication itself. Reminder is the alternative circulation: mention repeatedly returns knowledge to attention, and benefit occurs where trust allows that transmission to be received.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communities inherit a repeatable discourse of refusal, while reminder interrupts that transmission with beneficial recall.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:52-53 earlier peoples repeat the labels “sorcerer” and “madman” as if by mutual counsel; 51:54-55 turning away is released from blame and reminder continues for believers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The text treats rejection as a social inheritance and remembrance as a counter-transmission rather than as isolated individual opinions.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Asymmetric Service and Provision

subchannels.name: Created Beings Assigned to Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden and visible beings are created within a servant relation whose proper operation is worshipful obedience.
subchannels.active_motifs: creation (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); hidden jinn (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); visible human being (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); servitude relation (`quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`); worshipful obedience (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); subjecting another to service (`quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Jinn and humans differ in visibility but occupy the same created role. The lexical range of service makes worship concrete as directed obedience while the creation relation prevents the servant from becoming the source of the master's sufficiency.

subchannels.name: The Provider Who Does Not Need Feeding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desire for incoming provision and food is denied, while outgoing allotment, feeding power, and durable strength are affirmed.
subchannels.active_motifs: desire or will (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); allotted provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); food (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); feeding another (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); deity and object of worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); strength (`quranic:root_001274:B001/m01`); toughness and solidity (`quranic:root_001396:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Provision has a fixed direction. The deity does not occupy the recipient's side of the food relation; strength and solidity identify the source from which allotment and feeding proceed without replenishment from servants.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Created beings are oriented toward service, whereas the Creator's provision and strength exclude reciprocal need.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:56 jinn and humans are created to worship, and 51:57-58 no provision or feeding is sought from them because God is the strong Provider.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The servant relation is clarified economically: worship cannot be payment, food supply, or reinforcement for the one who already supplies and sustains.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Measured Turns at the Well

subchannels.name: The Comparable Full Bucket
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of a culpable group receive an equal, full bucket as their allotted portion.
subchannels.active_motifs: grievance and liability (`quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`); withholding or violating rights (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`); allotted portion (`quranic:root_000521:B006/m01`); full water bucket (`quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`); equality or likeness (`quranic:root_001397:B001/m03`); companions as a group (`quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 51:59 `ظَلَمُ` (ظ ل م), `ذَنُوبًا/ذَنُوبِ` (ذ ن ب), `مِّثْلَ` (م ث ل), `أَصْحَٰبِ` (ص ح ب).
subchannels.synthesis: The surface “share” retains the concrete mechanics of drawing water: a bucket is filled, assigned, and compared with the portions of earlier companions. Equality here does not lessen judgment; it specifies its measured completeness.

subchannels.name: The Turn That Cannot Be Hurried
subchannels.scene_or_process: The recipient tries to accelerate a threatening allotment whose date is already fixed.
subchannels.active_motifs: haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); menace within a promise (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); fixed appointment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); day as bounded time (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); decisive event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); concealing truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Haste is futile because the portion belongs to an ordered sequence and the promise carries its own appointment. The final Day is therefore the temporal equivalent of the full bucket: a measured allotment arriving exactly on its turn.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A due portion arrives as a full, comparable share on an appointed turn that cannot be hurried.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 51:59 the wrongdoers have a `ذَنُوبًا` like their companions' and are told not to hasten it; 51:60 fixes the deniers' promised day.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The threatened “share” becomes a full water bucket drawn in sequence, turning judgment into an allotted turn at a communal well.

parent_channels.name: P3 (51:38-60): Created Correspondence

subchannels.name: Designed Counterparts and Kinds
subchannels.scene_or_process: Things are measured into finished forms and arranged as counterparts, classes, and peers.
subchannels.active_motifs: the whole with all its parts (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); entity or thing (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`); pre-measuring and cutting to design (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); creation (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); finished form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`); counterpart pair (`quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`); class or type (`quranic:root_000652:B004/m01`); peers by form or action (`quranic:root_000652:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Pairing first functions as an ordering principle. Measured formation gives each thing a definite shape, while counterpart, class, and peer relations make that shape legible within a structured plurality.

subchannels.name: Reproductive Pair and Recall
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spousal counterpart and a male term activate reproduction inside the command to recover recognition.
subchannels.active_motifs: creation (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); spousal pair (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); male (`quranic:root_000516:B001/m01`); recall (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The reproductive sense is a distinct operation within created correspondence. The latent male sense in the same root as remembering lets sexual complementarity become a mnemonic pressure: recognizing the pair is itself an act of recollection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Measured creation produces forms that become intelligible through relation to a counterpart.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 51:49 all things are created in pairs so that the hearer may remember.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pairing operates both as a taxonomy of comparable kinds and as a reproductive relation, while the root of remembrance itself supplies the latent male term.

parent_channels.name: S1. P3 (51:38-60): Flight into Exclusive Refuge
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An alarm triggers flight toward one manifest refuge while every alternative deity is refused constructed status.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fleeing (`quranic:root_001142:B001/m01`); deity and object of worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); assigning or creating a status (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); another or alternative (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); alarm and warning (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); manifest clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); explanatory clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 51:50 `فِرُّ` (ف ر ر), `ٱللَّهِ` (ء ل ه), `نَذِيرٌ` (ن ذ ر), `مُّبِينٌ` (ب ي ن); 51:51 `تَجْعَلُ` (ج ع ل), `ءَاخَرَ` (ء خ ر), `ٱللَّهِ/إِلَٰهًا` (ء ل ه), `نَذِيرٌ` (ن ذ ر), `مُّبِينٌ` (ب ي ن).
parent_channels.synthesis: Flight is not undirected escape but a movement whose destination is determined by exclusive deity. The warning supplies urgency, clarity supplies orientation, and the prohibition on making another god closes every rival refuge.

parent_channels.name: S2. Whole Surah: The Maysir Draw and Camel Shares
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Players take marked arrows from a leather holder, draw a named fifth arrow, slaughter a camel, and distribute edible portions according to the lot.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather holder or collected set of gambling arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); the fifth maysir arrow (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); maysir players, arrows, camel slaughter, and division by lots (`quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`); edible allotted share (`quranic:root_000043:B003/m01`); fortune or luck (`quranic:root_000560:B006/m01`); apportioning shares (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster forms a complete social practice in which a container, specialized arrow, players, animal, draw, and resulting food share all have distinct roles. It usefully pressures the surah's primary language of division, provision, and appointed portions: human allotment can depend on luck, whereas the promised reckoning and divine provision are repeatedly presented as truthful, measured, and fixed rather than chancy.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole Surah: Hide Made into a Waterskin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hairy hide is stripped, treated with plant tannin in measured applications, stitched at its edges, bound, and tested as a water container for leaks.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stripping the skin from a surface (`quranic:root_000120:B004/m01`); hide kept with hair or wool attached (`quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`); tree bark or leaves used for tanning (`quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`); a small measured application of tanning agent (`quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`); stitching one hide edge to another (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); leather waterskin (`quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`); thin spot or leaking hole in a skin (`quranic:root_001069:B007/m01`); binding and strengthening a waterskin (`quranic:root_001396:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: These motifs describe a continuous craft sequence from raw hide to serviceable vessel, including material, tanning agent, dosage, seam, reinforcement, and failure point. The scene materializes the surah's water, hospitality, and provision readings as created dependence on skilled preservation and carriage; it sharpens the closing contrast with the Provider, whose strength and giving require neither vessel nor replenishment.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole Surah: Herds Driven to Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Camels move toward water at night, arrive herd after herd, wait through alternating drawing turns, drink at the mouth of the well, re-enter for a second drink, and return at evening with milk as the pastoral yield.
parent_channels.active_motifs: herds sent successively to pasture or water (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); night drive toward the watering place (`quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`); water drawing by alternating turns (`quranic:root_000433:B011/m01`); watering at camels' mouths (`quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`); returning camels to drink again (`quranic:root_000464:B007/m01`); evening movement back to the resting enclosure (`quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`); camels and grazing livestock (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); recurring milk yield (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs complete a timed husbandry cycle with animals, route, destination, cooperative labor, repeated access, return, and productive outcome. This materializes the surah's opening motions and recurring dispatch language as regulated provision: what is “sent” comes in ordered succession, reaches a shared source by turns, and returns as sustenance rather than as undirected movement.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole Surah: Dry Ablution and Directed Prayer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper uses clean earth to wipe face and hands, then turns the face toward the prayer direction for embodied service.
parent_channels.active_motifs: prayer direction or qibla (`quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`); face, orientation, and destination (`quranic:root_001630:B002/m01`); dry ablution by wiping face and hands with earth (`quranic:root_001697:B002/m01`); worshipful obedience (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The four motifs form a compact rite of preparation, bodily orientation, and worship. It materializes “flee to God” and the purpose of worship as directed practice rather than abstract inclination: earth prepares the body, the face establishes destination, and service gives the turn its operative form.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole Surah: Ostrich Pair, Egg, and Chick
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A male ostrich and its counterpart produce an egg left in the open, from which a chick forms and emerges.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ostrich as male or female bird (`quranic:root_001525:B006/m01`); male ostrich (`quranic:root_000967:B006/m01`); ostrich egg left in the wilderness (`quranic:root_000180:B008/m01`); ostrich chick (`quranic:root_000248:B010/m01`); chick emerging from its egg (`quranic:root_001274:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Adult, sexed counterpart, egg, offspring, and hatching make this a complete desert reproduction scene rather than a bird inventory. It supports and concretizes the surah's primary sequence of impossible birth, sterile force, and created pairs: even an exposed egg on open ground carries a formed life that breaks from its shell, setting reproductive emergence against barrenness and reduction to residue.

parent_channels.name: S7. P1-P2 Bridge: The Earth Becomes an Archive
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1-P2 role-progression bridge; the sign-and-perception scene remains canonically placed in Parent 3, Subchannel C, and the retained-trace scene in Parent 8, Subchannel B. This entry places only their transition from discoverable evidence to a deliberately preserved historical witness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); fixed certainty (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`); inward insight (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); retained trace or memory (`quranic:root_000180:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a role progression in evidence. P1 asks the perceiver to find signs already present in earth and self; P2 shows judgment producing a trace and then preserving it as a sign for later perceivers. The earth therefore moves from field of observation to archive, while the local perception and ruin scenes retain their separate canonical placements.

parent_channels.name: S8. P2-P3 Bridge: Sterility Reversed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2-P3 same-root contrast; the impossible-birth scene remains canonically placed in Parent 6, Subchannel A, and the sterile-wind scene in Parent 10, Subchannel A. This entry places only the reversal in what sterility is allowed to produce.
parent_channels.active_motifs: barren womb (`quranic:root_001037:B001/m01`); boy or young son (`quranic:root_001103:B001/m01`); sterile wind (`quranic:root_001037:B002/m01`); decayed remains (`quranic:root_000601:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is an exact lexical reversal around `ع ق م`. In P2, barrenness describes a body whose expected outcome is overridden by the promised son; in P3, sterility describes a wind whose defining outcome is that nothing living follows it. The same closure to generation is defeated in one scene and weaponized in the other.

parent_channels.name: S9. P2-P3 Bridge: Non-Consumption Discloses Agency
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2-P3 repeated-scene and role-progression bridge; the untouched-meal scene remains canonically placed in Parent 5, Subchannel C, and divine provision in Parent 13, Subchannel B. This entry places only the disclosure produced when an expected recipient does not consume food.
parent_channels.active_motifs: eating (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`); tasting food (`quranic:root_001627:B004/m01`); desire or will (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); food (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); feeding another (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a repeated interaction signature with a change of scale. In P2, food is placed before apparent guests and their non-consumption reveals that ordinary guest roles do not apply; in P3, the denial of desired provision and feeding makes that asymmetry explicit for the Creator. Absence of eating first discloses messenger nature and then defines divine non-need.

parent_channels.name: S10. P2-P3 Bridge: Opposite Removals
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2-P3 contrast-and-reversal bridge; protected extraction remains canonically placed in Parent 8, Subchannel A, and capture and casting in Parent 9, Subchannel C. This entry places only the shared removal operation and its opposed destinations.
parent_channels.active_motifs: extracting from concealment (`quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`); safety and integrity (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`); forcible seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m02`); capture (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); casting away (`quranic:root_001466:B001/m01`); sea (`quranic:root_001697:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a reversal in removal's function. P2 takes protected occupants out of a condemned place toward safety; P3 takes the culpable ruler and his force out of their position and casts them into destruction. Judgment sorts by movement, but rescue and punishment assign opposite destinations to the removed object.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole Surah: Death, Shroud, Grave-House, and Estate
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Death releases a person from life, the body is covered and interred in a grave understood as a house, and property remains behind as an estate.
parent_channels.active_motifs: death expressed as being given rest (`quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`); shrouding and interring the dead (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`); grave as burial place (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m02`); grave called a house (`quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`); estate left by the dead (`quranic:root_000180:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Release, covering, burial place, and inheritance form one mortuary sequence in which body and possession separate. It usefully pressures the surah's scenes of ruined households and approaching account: a grave may become the body's last terrestrial house and wealth may pass on, but neither operation settles the promised reckoning or erases the trace left for later witnesses.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole Surah: A Right Documented and Restored
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A claimant's right is embodied in a title deed, recognized as the claimant's priority, and returned to its holder.
parent_channels.active_motifs: deed certifying a right (`quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`); priority and entitlement (`quranic:root_001684:B008/m01`); restoring a right to its owner (`quranic:root_000609:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Record, entitlement, and restitution make a compact legal recovery process. This materializes the right acknowledged in wealth at 51:19 and the coming account at 51:6 as more than voluntary generosity: the share has the force of a documented title whose proper outcome is restoration to the person entitled to it.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole Surah: From Proposal to Wedding House
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A suitor requests marriage, a dowry establishes material obligation, the bride is prepared with a scented face coating, and the groom's entry under a wedding pavilion establishes a new household.
parent_channels.active_motifs: marriage proposal (`quranic:root_000421:B002/m01`); woman's dowry (`quranic:root_000852:B007/m01`); saffron or perfume coating on a bride's face (`quranic:root_001105:B011/m01`); groom entering his bride under an erected pavilion (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); marriage as establishment of a house (`quranic:root_000166:B010/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Request, transfer, bodily preparation, entry, and residence form a complete social transition from two parties to one household. The scene materializes the surah's created pairing and promised child as a social as well as biological order: counterpart relation becomes public commitment, costly obligation, and a house capable of carrying lineage.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole Surah: Date Infusion Prepared and Drunk
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dates or raisins are dropped into a vessel and covered with water, the drink rests overnight, its surface develops lees or bubbles, and it is taken from a small cup in measured draughts until thirst ends.
parent_channels.active_motifs: date or raisin infusion made in a water-filled vessel (`quranic:root_001466:B006/m01`); liquid kept or cooled overnight in its container (`quranic:root_000166:B006/m01`); beverage lees or surface bubbles (`quranic:root_001143:B009/m01`); small cup holding little drink (`quranic:root_001105:B009/m01`); draught measured by breaths (`quranic:root_001533:B006/m01`); thirst ended by drinking (`quranic:root_000856:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Ingredient, vessel, waiting time, visible surface change, drinking measure, and bodily outcome make one preparation-and-consumption practice. It materializes hospitality and provision as processes serving embodied thirst, while usefully sharpening the surah's asymmetries of consumption: humans require prepared liquid and repeated draughts, whereas the messengers' untouched meal and the Provider's non-need suspend the ordinary recipient role.

parent_channels.name: S15. Whole Surah: Fitting, Honing, and Polishing a Weapon
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A craftsperson seats a point in its shaft, hones iron on stone, finishes the blade's surface, and produces a weapon whose edge and spine retain their hardness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fitting a spearpoint into its shaft (`quranic:root_000051:B011/m01`); honing iron, knife, or sword on stone (`quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`); long sharp arrowhead or blade (`quranic:root_000732:B006/m01`); polishing a sword (`quranic:root_000299:B007/m01`); hard keen iron or blade (`quranic:root_000516:B002/m01`); solid exposed spine of sword or arrow (`quranic:root_001396:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Point, shaft, abrasive, finish, edge, and spine form a bounded manufacture-and-maintenance scene. It usefully pressures the surah's language of authority and strength: a ruler's coercive force depends on fitted parts, abrasive work, and maintained hardness, whereas the Provider's strength and the elemental judgments require no crafted implement to remain effective.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole Surah: A Lie Becomes Public Talk
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A falsehood is fabricated, enters circulation as common talk, is carried between people to provoke discord, attacks a person's reputation, and leaves that person as a story repeated by others.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fabricated falsehood (`quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`); news renewed through conversation (`quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`); tale-bearing that sows discord (`quranic:root_000043:B009/m01`); backbiting and reputational attack (`quranic:root_001675:B013/m01`); person becoming public story (`quranic:root_000299:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Fabrication becomes a social transmission chain with maker, circulating utterance, carrier, injured reputation, and durable public outcome. This reframes P1's conflicting speech and P3's inherited “magician or madman” formula as the mechanics of rumor, while the truthful promise and corrective reminder oppose that chain with speech whose recurrence restores reality rather than manufacturing notoriety.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole Surah: Testing a Bow before the Hunt
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hunter inspects the gap between bow and string, draws the string to test tension, sets out, waits until prey comes within reach, and uses the calibrated hunting tool to obtain food.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bowstring clinging dangerously close to the bow (`quranic:root_000156:B005/m01`); bowstring standing away from the bow's belly (`quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`); testing a bow by drawing its string (`quranic:root_000526:B003/m01`); hunters setting out (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); prey coming within reach (`quranic:root_000421:B005/m01`); bow or trained raptor that feeds its owner (`quranic:root_000934:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Tool condition, calibration, departure, opportunity, strike, and subsistence outcome form one hunting process. It materializes provision as something a human seeker reaches only through tested tension and favorable timing; the closing declaration of the Provider thereby gains contrast with an agent whose food depends on equipment, pursuit, and prey entering range.
